events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Commemorating the day influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost a legend. Today, we reflect on the enduring impact and powerful lyrics of Tupac Shakur.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the death of groundbreaking guitarist Jimi Hendrix in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who left us on this day. His revolutionary guitar work continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles walked that famous zebra crossing. 'Abbey Road' is an absolute masterpiece – what's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon, still commanding the stage with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing that unmistakable swagger to British rock. As you were!

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine' – a song that continues to resonate with its powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: The First iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple released the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember when this changed everything? The original iPod is 25 today! What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic film franchise.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your ultimate 007 moment or song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the extraordinary life and timeless music of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: The White Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered 'The White Album'. Its eclectic mix still sparks debate – what are your hidden gems on it?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Voice
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the extraordinary Freddie Mercury. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' shifted gears for pop music. A pivotal album that showed their incredible evolution.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: Commemorating the tragic anniversary of John Lennon's death in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Peace
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world lost a voice for peace and a musical visionary. Remembering John Lennon today.
